params.prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic commercial, golden-hour city street, handheld, fast-cut multi-shot, the same young woman throughout (face from image 1, white lace camisole, gold chain choker). Shot 1 (0–2s): she walks toward camera along a tree-lined street with the ash-blonde cut of image 1, raises her phone for a selfie. Shot 2 (2–4s): phone-screen POV; shutter flash; in the photo her hair is now the black-and-red wolf cut of image 2; pull back to reveal the real her on the street also has the wolf cut; a red bus passes in the foreground and wipes the frame. Shot 3 (4–6s): side tracking shot at a zebra crossing, she now has the high sunset-orange ponytail of image 3, hops off the kerb mid-stride taking a selfie, ponytail swinging; whip pan. Shot 4 (6–8s): through a café window, she sits with a latte, hair in soft honey-brown curls like image 4, lifts the cup then takes a selfie; a glass door edge slides across the frame. Shot 5 (8–10s): locked selfie framing, her face centred and smiling, the background and hairstyle change on each beat: twin tails like image 5 at a graffiti wall, then a rooftop at dusk, then a riverside rail. Photoreal, consistent identity, only the hair and location change.
